name: Kristi Schwiebert
title: Superintendent, Cambrian School District
background: Schwiebert's career in Cambrian School District spans more than a decade. She joined the district in 2010 as Principal of Fammatre Elementary School. District officials then selected her to lead the newly established Steindorf K to 8 Magnet School, where she began work a year before the school opened and, per the district's account, played a key role in planning decisions ranging from facility design and classroom layout to curriculum development. (Source: Cambrian School District, Meet the Superintendent.)

After four years at Steindorf, she was promoted to Assistant Superintendent of Personnel in 2019, a role she held until she became Acting Superintendent in June 2021; the Governing Board appointed her permanent Superintendent on December 16, 2021. She holds a bachelor's degree in Liberal Studies from Cal Poly and a master's degree in Educational Leadership from San José State University. She has been a Cambrian resident since 2001 and has raised her family in the community. (Source: Cambrian School District, Meet the Superintendent.)

As Superintendent, Schwiebert is a listed author of Measure Q, the district's November 2026 parcel tax measure, alongside Board President Dr. Beth Erickson, following the Board's adoption of Resolution 25-26-19 placing the measure on the ballot at its June 18, 2026 meeting. (Source: scc-measure-q-2026.json in this voter guide.)
